{{Top}} {{MultipleIssues|image|updatecontent=[[Star Wars Resistance Season Two]], [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:WarningShot-CM_Jorge_Gonzalez.png]] |name=Kragan Gorr |homeworld=[[Mon Cala]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Quarren]]{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Blue]] |skin=Orange |cyber=Left [[Limb|forearm]] |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Grox's pirate crew]]''[[Choose Your Destiny: A Luke & Leia Adventure]]'' *[[Warbird gang]] *[[First Order]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We lackeys only take orders from one tyrant, Captain Kragan!|Drell|{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}}}} '''Kragan Gorr''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Quarren]] [[pirate]] who operated during the [[New Republic Era]]. Gorr led the [[Warbird gang]] and secretly [[Privateer|worked]] for the [[First Order]]. After raiding the ''[[Colossus]]'' refueling platform on behalf of the First Order, Gorr and his pirates turned against their First Order employers when the latter tricked them into [[Torra Doza's abduction|kidnapping]] [[Torra Doza]], the daughter of [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]], in order to gain a pretext for [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupying]] the refueling platform. Gorr and his pirates later helped [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']] led by [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Jarek Yeager]] to expel the First Order from the ''Colossus'' before [[Battle of Castilon|fleeing]] into space with their former enemies. ==Biography== ===Young pirate=== {{Quote|Kragan, you and Mirack see if there are any survivors. PALLAS-Eleven, you're with me.|Grox|}} Early in the [[Galactic Civil War]], Kragan Gorr was part of a [[Grox's pirate crew|pirate crew]] led by the [[Lasat]] [[Grox]]. The gang was hired to steal ships for the [[Tech Masters]] inside the [[Kiax Nebula]]. One day, they were able to lure in the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' and siphon its power. Grox led a boarding party onto the [[freighter]], consisting of him, Gorr, the [[Nephran]] [[Mirack]], and the [[assassin droid]] [[PALLAS-Eleven]]. Grox told Gorr and Mirack to check for survivors while he went off with Eleven. They found no one on board the [[light freighter]] and impounded it on [[Trionak]], intending to sell it. Unknown to the Gorr, [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] were hiding in a secret compartment. ===Pirate leader=== ====Deal with the First Order==== {{Quote|We will take care of them, Phasma, just like you asked. Pretty soon, Doza will be begging you to take control of the ''Colossus''.|Kragan Gorr to Captain Phasma|}} By [[34 ABY]], Gorr had lost his left [[Limb|forearm]] and was a leader of his own [[Warbird gang|pirate gang]]. Eventually, they were approached by the [[First Order]]. They [[Privateer|wanted his gang to attack]] the refueling station ''[[Colossus]]'' for the them so its [[captain]], [[Imanuel Doza]], could give up power to the [[First Order]] for protection. The First Order gave them equipment to do this, and they began running "[[Triple dark]]" attacks on the ''Colossus''. Gorr and his Warbirds operated from a [[sail barge]] called the ''[[Galleon]]'', which served as their base of operations.{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}} ====Failed attack==== {{Quote|Engage the power generators, and go for their fuel reserves.|Kragan Gorr leads an attack on the ''Colossus''|}} [[File:KraganPiratesHologram-TheTripleDark.png|thumb|right|250px|Gorr communicating with Major Vonreg.]] Gorr sent a [[Neimoidian]] named [[Hallion Nark]] to serve as a [[spy]] and inside agent, who soon contacted Gorr back, giving him an all clear for an assault on the ''Colossus''. Kragan soon led his [[pirate]]s, under the cover of a "Triple Dark" storm, to [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] the station. He ordered the other [[pilot]]s to engage the [[power generator]]s and target the [[fuel]] reserves. The ''Colossus'' defenses mobilized and [[Ace Squadron]] engaged the pirates. The pirates were able to take out at least two defense [[turret]]s regardless. However, a disturbance occurred through the comms and the pirates were stunned. Ace squadron was able to shoot one down, and Gorr ordered them to retreat after a communications overload caused by [[Kazuda Xiono]] was too distracting, preventing the pirates from communicating. After the battle, Gorr talked to [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] and [[Captain]] [[Phasma]], who were displeased with the pirates. Gorr assured them that Nark would be dealt with for his tactical mistake of losing his [[comlink]], and thus allowing Xiono to foil the pirates' attack. ====Infiltration of the ''Colossus''==== {{Quote|This kid mistook me for the crew ''and'' got me registered.''"
"''Maybe this will turn out better than stealing cargo. Our little mishap might just work to our advantage. Stay put and blend in. I'll have an assignment for you soon.|Synara San and Gorr|{{Resistance|Signal from Sector Six}}}} [[File:DariusGClassFreighter-SignalFromSectorSix.jpg|left|250pc|thumb|Gorr sent San and several men to raided a ''Darius G''-class freighter in Sector Six.]] Later, several of Gorr's pirates, led by [[Synara San]], raided a [[Darius G-class freighter|''Darius G''-class freighter]] in an [[Castilon asteroid field|asteroid field]] near [[Castilon]]. San was the sole survivor, as the rest of the pirates were killed by a [[Kowakian ape-lizard]]. She was rescued by [[Resistance]] members [[Poe Dameron]], Kazuda Xiono and two [[astromech droid]]s, who had picked up the freighter's distress signal and [[Investigation of a G-class freighter|investigated]]. The [[Mirialan]] pirate was brought to the ''Colossus'' by Xiono and [[Jarek Yeager]], as they thought she was a member of the freighter's crew. Once on the platform, San contacted Gorr and told him of the situation, including the failure of the raid and that she had been handed an opportunity to [[spy]] on the platform. Gorr conceded that this situation was better than any profits they may have attained from the raid, and ordered San to blend in, and that he would contact her soon with an assignment, before signing off. San soon contacted Gorr again, informing him that the ''Colossus''{{'}} defense turrets were temporarily out of operation. He told her to contact him again when Ace Squadron left the station for one of their missions. When this happened, San informed Gorr, who then prepared his pirates for another attack.{{Resistance|Synara's Score}} ====Successful raid==== {{Quote|That must be the targeting computer. We can't let them repair it.|Gorr, to his pirates|}} [[File:KraganGorr-SynarasScore.jpg|thumb|right|250px|From San's intel, Gorr launched an attack on the ''Colossus''.]] Gorr led his pirate gang in another [[Raid on the Colossus|attack]] the ''Colossus''. While they wreacked havoc on the station, Gorr noticed Xiono and Yeager carrying a component for the [[turbolaser]]'s [[targeting computer]] on a [[hoverlift]]. Gorr attacked them but they evaded him and flew up to the targeting computer. As they tried to install it, Gorr and two other pirates were dropped off to try and stop them. Gorr's two subordinates engaged the pair, but after Yeager knocked one of them off his hoverlift, he rammed it hoverlift into the other one, knocking them unconscious. Gorr shot at them, but Yeager shot back and disarmed him. Gorr then jumped onto the hoverlift and knocked Yeager's blaster out of his hand, before throwing Xiono off. While Yeager and Gorr wrestled, Xiono tried to push the component into the targeting computer. He shouted for Yeager to help him and Yeager shook his hoverlift so Gorr was left hanging off. Gorr, though, climbed back to Yeager and he reared the hoverlift away before it could ram the component. Yeager flew his hoverlift in for another attempt and Gorr tried to knock him off. However, the hoverlift was already flying towards the targeting computer at high speed. They both jumped off both it hit the component, slotting it into the targeting computer. The turbolasers began working again and fired on the pirates. Gorr ordered a retreat and returned to his shuttle to leave. ===Resistance involvement=== Gorr eventually discovered that the pilots who had rescued San from the derelict freighter were in fact members of the Resistance, and when he next made contact with her, during a delayed regular check-in call, he informed her about this. He showed her a security camera image from the freighter of Xiono, Dameron and their droids inside the ship, but due to smoke and poor lighting in the image, San was unable to recognize anyone in the picture after studying it for a brief time, before she was forced to end the transmission due to hearing Xiono approaching.{{Resistance|Bibo (episode)}} ===Kidnapping Torra Doza=== Seeking a pretext to occupy the ''Colossus'', Commander Pyre and Captain Phasma hired Gorr to [[Torra Doza's abduction|kidnap]] [[Torra Doza]], the daughter of Captain Doza. While Kragan was initially reluctant to launch more attacks on the ''Colossus'' due to losses sustained in the earlier raids, he agreed in return to Pyre and Phasma agreeing to triple the money. Kragan then contacted his spy Synara, chastising her for not sending frequent reports and warning her not to get too close to the ''Colossus'' inhabitants. Uncertain of her loyalty, Gorr did not reveal the specifics of his plan but ordered Synara to expect fellow pirates [[Valik]] and [[Drell]] in a shipping container and pass them through security into [[Doza Tower]]. Kragan reassured her that they would get paid and that she would get to come home tonight. Acting under Kragan's orders, a reluctant Synara socialized with Torra, Xiono, and Ryvora while gathering information on Doza Tower's layout. Later that night, she met Valik and Drell and helped them infiltrate Doza Tower. After realizing the true purpose of their mission, Synara experienced a change of heart and angrily confronted Gorr via [[holoprojector]]. Gorr dismissed Synara's concerns and chided her for becoming "too soft" and attached to the ''Colossus'' inhabitants. He also told her to rendezvous with Valik and Drell's [[skiff]] if she wanted to come home. Undaunted, Synara warned Xiono and Captain Doza, who dispatched the Aces after Valik and Drell, who had kidnapped Torra. [[File:BetrayingPirates-TheDozaDilemma.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gorr eventually was betrayed by the First Order.]] Valik, Drell, and the kidnapped Torra managed to rendezvous with Captain Gorr and the other Warbirds aboard the sail barge ''[[Galleon]]''. Shortly later, [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] arrived aboard an [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class shuttle]] under the pretext of parleying with the Warbirds. However, Major Vonreg instead shot Drell and [[Skreek]], and rescued Doza. Following the First Orders betrayal of the Warbird gang, Gorr contacted Synara the following day to warn her that the First Order had betrayed them and that the deal was over. Synara ended the transmission after hearing Kaz and BB-8 approaching her quarters. Due to the Warbirds' kidnapping attempt, the First Order was able to convince Captain Doza to accept a [[Occupation of the Colossus|military occupation]] of the ''Colossus''.{{Resistance|The First Order Occupation}} ===First Order occupation of the ''Colossus''=== The First Order established a significant [[Colossus garrison|military garrison]] on the ''Colossus'' including [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] and [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]]. This deterred the Warbirds from launching further attacks on the ''Colossus''. While the First Order brought a sense of security to the station, this came at the cost of increased restrictions including identity checks. During the occupation, Synara San contacted Gorr in an attempted to seek help to escape the ''Colossus''. However, Kragan was unable to assist her due to the First Order military presence and chided her for not escaping wen she had the chance. Synara was ultimately able to [[Escape from the Colossus|escape]] the station with the help of Kaz. Kragan and his Warbirds later rendezvoused with Synara's [[escape pod]] at sea. Later, Kragan and his pirates including Synara and Valik received a distress transmission from Kazuda Xiono calling the Resistance for help against the First Order.{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} Kragan and his pirates answered Kaz's call for help and came to the aid of the ''Colossus''. The pirates used the ''Galleon'' to drive away TIE fighters. They then boarded the ''Colossus'' and joined the residents as they fled into hyperspace.{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}} ===Having a party at Aunt Z's Tavern=== At [[Aunt Z's Tavern]], it is unknown that the [[gravity generator]] has shut down by [[MB-13A]], as Kragan was about to drink and has been hit by [[Gork]] that [[Leoz]] kicked him. So, Kragan punch him. As the gravity is back, Gork has landed on top of Kragan.{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}} ===Salvage the dreadnought=== As he thinks Kaz wants to help to [[Skirmish over D'Qar|salvage]] the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' to get the [[coaxium]] and he agreed. He ordered Valik into the hangar nice and easy, and prepared to board which there's still power. As they got inside, the crew started to salvage, so Kaz, Synara, Kragan, [[CB-23]] and [[Neeku Vozo|Neeku]] entered the hyperdrive chamber as they tried to get the coaxium out, until the First Order is here. After the coaxium is out and caught by Kaz, Kragan orders to head back to the ''Galleon''. As the ''Galleon'' is out of the [[Siege Dreadnought]], the engine has been hit by the [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s as he ordered Synara to fire the starboard cannons and ordered Valik to fire the port cannons and when the ''Galleon'' approach to the ''Colossus''{{'}} hangar he tells her to take her in gently, Valik tells Kragan she's trying, and after that Kaz, Synara and Neeku head to the [[Colossus hyperdrive chamber|hyperdrive chamber]].{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} ===Hunt the jakoosk=== Kragan smiled about what to the people of ''Colossus'' since there's no food. As Drell thinks that Doza's "got a real mess on his hands", Kragan said, "Which means an opportunity for us". As he came to the tavern as he said, "it might be difficult for you Aces, but not for me and my crew", as Aunt Z said if you can bring me jakoosk, he and his crew eat for free. He told her, "Unlike Doza, at least I'm not afraid to try". Tora was angry at Kragan about, as he said, "That's the only smart thing he's done since we left Castilon". Kragan and his crew came onboard the ''Galleon'' approaches the [[Water|ice]] [[moon]] [[Celsor 3]] and start to [[Mission to Celsor 3|hunt]] for the jakoosk. He was delighted to see the jakoosk and attempted to kill it, but it has failed. After the jakoosk have been defeated by Kaz with the [[blaster cannon]], he and his crew get ready to eat for the jakoosk meat.{{Resistance|Hunt on Celsor 3}} ===A saboteur=== Kragan was surprised about a blue [[Nikto]] [[Nenavakasa Nalor]] has insult the pirates for drain nearly half the station's power into their sail barge ''Galleon''. After Nalor revealed to be the real culprit, Kaz Gorr needs them to unplug their power source. Although despite Gorr reluctant to do it, Kaz apologizes for blaming them for draining the ship's power but emphasizes they have no time left and tells them there will be nothing left if they don't help him. Kragan Gorr gives the order to unplug the pirate's power source, allowing the ''Colossus'' to escape.{{Resistance|The Engineer}} ===Purchasing super battle droids=== [[File:PirateB2sColossus-TheMutiny.png|thumb|right|300px|Kragan with his B2 super battle droids.]] Not too long before the [[Battle of Exegol]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' his sail barge, the ''Galleon,'' arrived at the [[Unidentified icy asteroid|rendezvous point]] with ''[[Meson Martinet]]'', which was led by [[Sidon Ithano]] of [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|his crew]]. As he asked how the Crimson Corsair had been faring of late; Sidon told him cut the pleasantries. Kragan was very pleased to see a [[B1's B2-series super battle droid battalion|battalion]] of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, but he saw the merchandise looked worn out and ask if they can lower the price, in an unsuccessfully attempting to haggle the [[arms dealer]] in the process. When Ithano raises his [[blaster rifle]], he ordered Drell to give the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for the Crimson Corsair and with the battle droids further his plan to [[Mutiny on the Colossus|take over the ''Colossus'']].{{Resistance|The Mutiny}} ==Personality and traits== [[File:KraganGorrPirateCaptain-CM.png|thumb|250px|left|Kragan Gorr with his ACP array gun.]] {{Quote|I took you off the streets of Vanqor. Raised you like a daughter. And this is how you thank me?"
"They could be doing far worse. Consider my debt to you paid, Kragan.|Kragan Gorr and Synara San, upon Gorr's exile from the ''Colossus''|{{Resistance|The Mutiny}}}} Kragan Gorr was a male Quarren with blue eyes and orange skin. He had a cybernetic left forearm. Gorr was the leader of a pirate gang who was willing to work as a [[mercenary]] for the First Order. After the Warbirds incurred significant setbacks during two raids on the ''Colossus'', Gorr demanded that his First Order employers triple their payments and supplies to cover his lost expenditure. Unlike Synara, Gorr had no scruples about kidnapping Doza and chided her for becoming "soft" and growing attached to the ''Colossus''{{'}} inhabitants. Commander Pyre was able to exploit Gorr's pecuniary motivation by tricking him into kidnapping Torra Doza; giving the First Order a pretext to occupy the ''Colossus''. ==Behind the scenes== Kragan Gorr first appeared on [[October 2]], [[2018]] in the [[canon]] junior novel ''[[Choose Your Destiny: A Luke & Leia Adventure]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]], which allows readers to make choices as they read, with one official canon path. He was first pictured on [[October 14]] in "[[The Triple Dark]]," the second episode of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated series. There, he was voiced by [[Gary Anthony Williams]], who previously voiced [[Riff Tamson]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{TCW|Prisoners}} and [[Gron]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.{{Rebels|Legends
